maya (PM): quick proposal: 2-week design partner pulse to validate the DP gating criteria for the upcoming routing+cache launch. Recruit 6 partners (4 hosted,1 dedicated,1 private). Goals: collect 20 canonical prompts, 3 repro cases each, and produce a launch gate doc. Thoughts? :wave:

kevin (Eng): sounds good. operational ask: any mitigation we ship during the pulse must be reversible within 1 hour. small fixes only (<4 dev-days).

rachel (CS): recruitment: prefer partners with chat + background batch jobs. incentive: $1.5k credit + fast-track support. will ask for one eng and one PM from partner.

tim (Research): scoring: simple rubric: severity (1-5), exposed users (1-5), strategic fit (0/1). rank by weighted sum. capture 1-2 partner quotes.

maya (PM): logistics owners: outreach=rachel, onboarding kit=tim, telemetry shim=kevin, sprint epic=maya. Will open intake form today.

ops-bot: Reminder 1: add epic dp-pulse-6112 to R-Board and tag oncall.

maya (PM): ok will post intake link once ready. Please confirm EOW deliverables. :thumbsup:
